extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, final hearing listed; costs estimated to FDR
extracted.summary: A family solicitor asks whether Lodestar could fund approximately £16,500 of costs for her client, the husband in financial remedy proceedings at the Central Family Court, where the matrimonial assets are around £85,000 and a final hearing is listed for 14 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have logged the details you provided, including the estimated costs of £16,500, the approximate £85,000 of matrimonial assets and the hearing listed for 14 October. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and address, a breakdown of the costs estimate and your firm's engagement terms, details and valuations of the family home and buy-to-let properties together with any existing charges over them, and confirmation of the current procedural position including whether an FDR has been listed. A member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an indication that funding will be offered or on what terms.
